shadows.name: paper-lift
shadows.purpose: Separates a record from the desk.

shadows.name: stamp-lift
shadows.purpose: Reserved for a primary operational action.

motion.name: handover-transfer
motion.purpose: A newly logged row settles into the handover record.

components.name: Stamped Entry Action
components.description: The single urgent action on an operational surface.
components.css: .ds-entry { background:#a84d3d; color:#fffdf7; border:2px solid #a84d3d; box-shadow:3px 3px 0 #702d25; padding:0 16px; min-height:44px; font:700 12px/1 'DM Mono',monospace; letter-spacing:.08em; cursor:pointer; } .ds-entry:hover { transform:translate(-1px,-1px); box-shadow:4px 4px 0 #702d25; } .ds-entry:focus-visible { outline:3px solid #182a33; outline-offset:3px; }

components.name: Record State Stamp
components.description: A compact status mark that reads like a verified ledger annotation.
components.css: .ds-stamp { display:inline-block; color:#32694b; background:#e2efe3; border:1px solid currentColor; padding:5px 7px; font:700 10px/1 'DM Mono',monospace; letter-spacing:.08em; transform:rotate(-1deg); }

components.name: Paper Record
components.description: A structural record surface for lists, forms, and handovers.
components.css: .ds-record { background:#fffdf7; border-top:4px solid #182a33; box-shadow:0 9px 22px rgb(24 40 49 / .08); padding:24px; color:#182831; } .ds-record small { color:#52646b; font:700 11px/1 'DM Mono',monospace; letter-spacing:.1em; } .ds-record h3 { margin:10px 0 0; font:500 24px/1.1 Fraunces,Georgia,serif; }

narrative.overview: ControlEasy is a trustworthy working record passed between gatehouse attendants, administrators, and residents. Warm paper, ruled rows, stamps, and a dark operational rail make work legible without turning it into a generic dashboard.
keyCharacteristics: Charcoal rail with warm paper workspace
Editorial display type and monospaced metadata
Structural rules and stamps over floating cards

rules.name: Rare Stamp Rule
rules.body: Brick is never a decorative wash. Use it to identify the next consequential action, a selected location, or a recorded exception.

rules.name: Paper Stack Rule
rules.body: Lift only a record that needs separation from the desk. Use borders, rules, and tonal paper before adding shadow.

dos: Do make the next operational action obvious with one brick stamp.
Do use ruled rows, tab dividers, and monospaced labels to make dense records fast to scan.
donts: Don't replace records with a field of isolated rounded cards.
Don't use gradients, glass effects, or generic blue dashboard accents.
Don't use system UI fonts for display hierarchy or operational labels.
